title: Harden scoped indexes against stale state and hash collisions
description: Make scoped allocation fail with an actionable error when index-{branchId}.json records a different branch name than the current branch. Before allocating, compare the proposed short ID with loaded tasks and advance past already-used sequences so a stale or manually lowered index cannot duplicate a task. Preserve atomicity and acceptable gaps when index persistence succeeds but task publication fails. Add internal flat-file tests for stale indexes, missing scoped indexes with existing scoped tasks, exact 32-bit hash-collision metadata mismatch, concurrent writers, and failure paths that do not overwrite task files. Avoid broad scheduler changes.
